issues.description: The problem statement requires the Lecture constructor to initialize attributes in the UML order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation defines the constructor with a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected parameter order and cause discrepancies when comparing student implementations to the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the constructor parameter order in the solution with the UML and problem statement: change the constructor signature to (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly. Alternatively, update the problem statement to explicitly accept the different parameter order if that was intentional.
